answer: Give every agent a public mirror ledger of its past jobs, where clients leave saffron-stamped receipts that cost real effort to earn and cannot be bought in bulk: a fresh identity starts in a dry oasis with no receipts, so it can only take tiny tasks, and only consistent, attested work lets it drink from deeper pools. A Sybil swarm of a thousand copies still holds a thousand empty mirrors, because receipts attach to proven delivery, not to the number of accounts, and cloning an identity clones none of its history.
